Step 3 misattributes a claim to the stimulus: 'Read the label on the map. It calls the line the Line of Demarcation of 1493, the papal line, 100 leagues west of the Azores and Cape Verde.' Viewed the Hart map (full image and a zoomed crop of the demarcation line): the label reads only 'LINE OF DEMARCATION (1493)'. The 100-leagues measurement is true history (1493 papal bull Inter Caetera) but is not on the map, and the general presents it as part of what the label says. Same defect class as the earlier 0088/0143/0144 stimulus-attribution fixes. Fix: keep the label reading, state the 100-leagues fact as background knowledge rather than as a label reading.
